name: spook
works_with: Claude Code through its plugin marketplace. Other agents can use the skill folder directly
short: Teaches your agent Spook for Home Assistant: its 100+ actions, extra triggers and conditions, and the broken references it reports.
what: Spook is a Home Assistant custom integration that finds "ghosts": references to entities, devices, areas and labels that no longer exist, plus leftovers like empty areas and unused labels. It reports them in Repairs and adds over a hundred actions, triggers and conditions. This skill gives your agent all of that in a form it can look up, with rules for fixing things safely.
who: Home Assistant users who already run Spook and manage their setup from an agent through the API or Home Assistant's MCP server. Skip it if you don't use Spook. The skill only helps when Spook is installed.
needs: Home Assistant with the Spook integration installed (docs at spook.boo)
An admin user for the registry and repairs actions
An AI agent connected to your Home Assistant

steps.title: Install it in Claude Code
steps.text: Add the marketplace, then install the plugin.

steps.title: Or use the folder with another agent
steps.text: Point your agent at `plugins/spook/skills/spook` in the repo.

steps.title: Check Spook is there
steps.text: Spook's actions only exist when it's installed. Look for `spook.boo` or `repairs.list` among the actions, or a `spook` config entry.

try.label: From the SKILL.md
try.where: Your agent, connected to Home Assistant
try.text: Ask it to run `repairs.list` with `domain: spook` and explain the open issues, then fix the references that point at renamed entities.

watch: Spook is not affiliated with, endorsed or supported by the Home Assistant project, and comes without warranty.
Registry actions (create, delete, rename, labels, areas and more) and some repairs actions need an admin user. That gives your agent a lot of power over your setup.

The skill tells the agent to fix references rather than rename entity IDs, to leave alone what it didn't create, and to ask before removing leftovers. Orphaned statistics don't come back once deleted.
Home Assistant's own MCP server doesn't expose every action. Wrap a Spook action in a script and expose that to reach it from there.
